What Makes a Memorable Matcha Spot

Not all green powder is created equal. This concept uses three useful criteria for discovering a great cup. Sample venue details still need to be checked before publication:

spa
Farm & Cultivar Transparency Clear traceability to Uji, Shizuoka, Yame, or Kagoshima gardens.
cyclone
Chasen Whisk Craftsmanship Hand-whisked to order at optimal 70°C water with micro-aerated foam.
inventory_2
Unsweetened Base Standard Zero premixed sugary syrups, highlighting the natural umami & gentle l-theanine.
